usedFor: Zoho Billing holds quotes and invoices, and Google Docs is where “Add or Replace Text In Tab” writes them out.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in Zoho Billing, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each invoice is written into a Doc tab, giving you readable billing notes beside your other documents.

watchOut: “Updated Invoice” in Zoho Billing is polling and runs for invoices paid in a chosen window, so set it.
